_doc: Cost-vs-looks effect groups (notes/cost-vs-looks.md). Read by cost_vs_looks.ps1 (order = cycle order; risky groups last) and cost_vs_looks.py (table columns). pso = shader-hash fragments matched against psoswap's 'vs=.. ps=..' / 'cs=..' set description (stage-qualified 'ps=xxxx' only matches that stage); markers = engine marker names ('Prefix*' allowed). gp2_ms = pc2 GP2 file #125 rows summed (MinRun 4, so +-absorbed neighbours). expect_* and repl_* are the PRE-FILL from the static analysis, to be confirmed or overturned by the run.

groups.label: SSFOG fog composite (screen-space apply of the froxel fog)
groups.expect_looks: volumetric fog / light shafts disappear; large change in foggy areas, small in clear ones
groups.replacement: half-res composite + bilateral upsample (fog is low-frequency)

groups.label: VFSCAT froxel fog scattering (async CS 641524ee)
groups.expect_looks: fog freezes at the last computed volume (stale): little change while static; real loss = FOG_all
groups.replacement: temporal reprojection: update 1/2 of the froxel slices per frame + reuse history (fog is low-frequency); or 120x67x48 grid (VOLUMETRIC STANDARD = -58 % froxels)

groups.label: Volumetric fog total (VFSCAT + SSFOG)
groups.expect_looks: no volumetric fog at all; the scene loses depth haze and god rays
groups.replacement: see VFSCAT + SSFOG

groups.label: VCLOUD volumetric clouds (async CS b76874bb, DrawSky)
groups.expect_looks: clouds freeze (stale) - static diff small; sky loses cloud motion. Clouds cover a small share of most views
groups.replacement: temporal amortisation: march 1/4 of the pixels per frame (checkerboard / Bayer 2x2) + reprojection, as Horizon/UE do; clouds move slowly
groups.repl_risk: low (ghosting on fast camera turns at cloud edges)

groups.label: Everything inside the DrawSky marker (clouds CS + sky draws)
groups.expect_looks: sky / clouds missing (upper bound of the sky's visual weight)
groups.replacement: cache the sky dome (non-cloud part) per time-of-day step

groups.label: RefProbe GI gather (cs 4b4c3cbe)
groups.expect_looks: indirect light freezes (stale) or goes dark if the target is transient; GI is the main 'mood' lighting in interiors
groups.replacement: checkerboard / half-rate gather with temporal reuse (GI is low-frequency); invisible-gpu.md says no temporal interleave exists today

groups.label: HBAO? (ps a42ffb78; GP2 label 'RefProbe / HBAO')
groups.expect_looks: contact shadows in corners / under objects vanish (subtle at 7 rays half-res)
groups.replacement: already 7 rays + half-res at 702p; GTAO-style 2-slice with temporal accumulation

groups.label: ps 78abc2af ('RefProbe / GFM-Hiz', unclear)
groups.expect_looks: unknown - this run identifies it
groups.replacement: decide after the run

groups.label: AMBSL (vs 0ad688da ps ff5fcc12, 54 draws)
groups.expect_looks: ambient light spots / local ambient lights missing (small, local)
groups.replacement: merge the 54 small light draws into one tiled/clustered pass

groups.label: ESM exponential shadow map blur (ps 47ef1c9b)
groups.expect_looks: fog shafts / LPV shadowing go stale; nearly invisible while static
groups.replacement: [Patches] ESM1 (2048->1024, built, A/B #473)

groups.label: Skinned / dynamic shadow casters (SM-Sfb ps c4656a8d, ~80 draws)
groups.expect_looks: characters and moving objects stop casting shadows (clearly visible near the player)
groups.replacement: distance cull of far skinned casters / lower cascade LOD for cascades 1-2 (VSM pages already cache statics)

groups.label: Everything inside 'Cascade *' markers
groups.expect_looks: cascade shadow maps keep last content (stale) - dynamic shadows freeze
groups.replacement: update the far cascade every 2nd frame (classic amortisation)

groups.label: WDO sun-shadow resolve / mask blur family (vs 26bcdc9d)
groups.expect_looks: sun shadows on the screen go stale / wrong; high visual weight
groups.replacement: wdo28 latency rewrite (built, A/B pending); half-res mask blur

groups.label: SSR (PBRLR ps 0576ae5e)
groups.expect_looks: wet-floor / glossy reflections vanish (visible on water and wet stone only)
groups.replacement: SSR STANDARD = half-size (menu)

groups.label: Bloom chain (ps e6efc8ff, 04c1052d, 18a4c2bb, 17149dca)
groups.expect_looks: glow around bright lights/fire disappears or freezes
groups.replacement: run the chain at render res (POSTEFFECT_RESOLUTION STANDARD, -0.39 ms on the 9070) or a dual-filter (Kawase) bloom

groups.label: 'motion blur' rows (vs d8fc9faf; settings-cost says this label may be FFX shaders)
groups.expect_looks: static view: no difference if it is motion blur; something else if the label is wrong
groups.replacement: MOTION_BLUR LIGHTEST (2 samples) or tile-max early-out

groups.label: TOONEDGE2 outline CS (318fa766)
groups.expect_looks: character/object outlines (toon edge) vanish or freeze
groups.replacement: toonedge2 rewrite (dropped: not exact)

groups.label: PB2RIPPLE / PB2DECAL (ps c013d811)
groups.expect_looks: rain ripples / decals (blood, scorch) missing - local, scene dependent
groups.replacement: merge decal draws; lower ripple normal-map res

groups.label: G1E particles / effects (ps 2c4db869, 4c1f06a5, d4ed3fe4)
groups.expect_looks: particles (embers, dust, spirit wisps) gone
groups.replacement: half-res particle buffer + upsample (classic for soft particles)

groups.label: GFM (vs fce25fe6 ps 1c49bbd5, 21 draws)
groups.expect_looks: AO blur / GFM output missing: noisy or stale AO
groups.replacement: separable blur at half res

groups.label: IGP + PFB async compute (cs 2ebe78c9, e7ffdc63)
groups.expect_looks: unknown (probe GI update / particle field?) - this run identifies it
groups.replacement: decide after the run

groups.label: Ocean / water (Ultramarine* markers)
groups.expect_looks: water surface missing/frozen (only at water spots)
groups.replacement: AS ocean wait fix (#503) is the scheduling side

groups.label: HUD / UI quads (ExeUI ps 9a76cbef, 030dc811, 5747cd78)
groups.expect_looks: HUD elements gone (cost reference for 'what UI costs')
groups.replacement: cache static HUD layers in one texture

groups.label: PB2 material family vs be0fa132 (opaque world)
groups.expect_looks: a family of world surfaces disappears - COST reference only, not removable
groups.replacement: material simplification at distance (shader LOD)

groups.label: PB2 material family vs 2c6f629c (~150 draws)
groups.expect_looks: world surfaces missing - COST reference
groups.replacement: instancing of the small repeated draws (CPU side, round3 5b)

groups.label: PB2 meshlet families (vs 1559714c, 70d0ee9f, f311c8e2 TREE2)
groups.expect_looks: meshlet world geometry (rocks, buildings, trees) missing - COST reference
groups.replacement: MSV slot-chain scalarization (built, same picture, #505)

groups.label: STD family vs 96690c3b (~160 draws)
groups.expect_looks: STD-shaded objects missing - COST reference

groups.label: post compose (vs d21b4b07 ps 6a305be4) - RISKY: final image may freeze
groups.expect_looks: tonemap / compose missing: image freezes or goes black - cost reference
groups.replacement: fuse compose into the FSR3 RCAS / output pass (render-architecture.md)

groups.label: Meshlet preculling (marker MeshletPreculling) - RISKY
groups.expect_looks: visible set from a stale/empty list: geometry missing or frozen - COST reference
groups.replacement: round 4: MIC SAT if-conversion, MshLod#2 uniform fast path; async-compute move (shadows-culling B1b)

groups.label: Meshlet instance culling (marker MeshletInstanceCulling) - RISKY
groups.expect_looks: geometry missing / stale - COST reference
groups.replacement: MIC SAT if-conversion (7 -> 2 serial round trips)

groups.label: Meshlet LOD resolve (marker MeshletResolveLOD) - RISKY
groups.expect_looks: geometry missing / stale LOD - COST reference
groups.replacement: MshLod#2 uniform fast path (round 4)

groups.label: FSR3 upscaler (marker FSR3) - RISKY: output freezes
groups.expect_looks: output frozen / garbage - cost reference for 'what the upscaler costs'
groups.replacement: FSR_SHARPNESS 0 (fused, small); a lighter upscaler only if FSR3 > ~1.5 ms is confirmed
